messages.subject: Alpha not working in geom_rect
parts:

I am trying to activate the alpha argument to work, but for some reason it does not to play with me. Anybody has an idea why?

 

 

p <- ggplot(data = prediction_df, aes(x=x, y=prediction, fill=threshold)) + geom_area(colour="black", size=.2, alpha=.4) + scale_fill_brewer(palette="Set1", breaks=rev(levels(prediction_df$threshold)))

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: Alpha not working in geom_rect
parts:
That's actually surprising; I assume it has to do with the oddity of
specifying constant values in an aes() call. The solution is to use
annotate, which is what you want to do in this case anyway:

p + annotate("rect", xmin=2, xmax=10, ymin=0, ymax=1, fill="black", alpha=0.5)

Ben
